bedroomIndividuality.status: Preferred design principle; exact room proposals await feedback
bedroomIndividuality.principle: A shared warm modern house palette with distinct bedroom moods, focal points, headboard shapes, lighting and textile details. Avoid repeating the same walnut/LED headboard wall throughout.

ownerbed.direction: The most layered bedroom: a low walnut headboard band, softly textured mushroom walls, generous neutral upholstery and gentle indirect light.

bed2.direction: A lighter, softer guest room with a tall oatmeal upholstered headboard, quiet painted wall framing and ceramic bedside lamps.

bed3.direction: An airy room led by its windows: a low upholstered bed, tailored neutral textiles, slim dark accents and a quietly textured dresser wall.

bed5.direction: A slightly moodier penthouse bedroom with warm mushroom walls, a charcoal upholstered bed and sculptural dark lamps, balanced by ivory linen and trim.

bedroomIndividuality.costStrategy: Concentrate the strongest custom headboard detail in the owners suite; favor retail furniture, painted trim and focused finishes in the guest rooms.

bedroomFlooring.direction: Natural neutral oak floors with loose rugs beneath beds in all four bedrooms, including penthouse.

proposedDirection.status: Designer recommendation awaiting further taste feedback
proposedDirection.wallFinish: Sample a controlled, low-sheen Roman Clay/plaster-like finish in warm mushroom or stone taupe for selected uninterrupted feature walls. Compare with fine brush-applied limewash. Avoid heavy mottling.

roomApplication.great: Develop selected textured-wall and illuminated-art scheme using mineral/plaster-like finish in fireplace-side wall bays; retain source architecture and both high transoms.
roomApplication.ownerbed: Keep selected low wood band and soft light. Compare a plaster-like finish above the band with the original linen-look wallpaper. This is a proposed change, not a selected material.
roomApplication.dining: Retain selected painted frames; use compatible smooth paint on trim and optionally a restrained mineral finish within broad wall fields after a mock-up. Do not assume a wall-only coating is suitable for all trim substrates.

proposedDirection.accentStrategy: Keep warm neutral backgrounds, warm wood, black picture/floating canvas frames and selected dark lamps/charcoal accessories. Bring green through plants and leafy stems. Retain neutral artwork and warm neutral/charcoal textiles from A/C/E. Final species, sizes, pots, placement and purchased items remain open.
proposedDirection.workingSummary: Warm modern luxury with textured warm neutral walls, walnut furniture and simple wood detailing, layered lighting, green plants and deliberate black/dark accents. User prefers plants-only green, with neutral art and textiles, from the six green/black previews. Aim for a welcoming, sophisticated builder-showcase home using phased, practical construction.

finishZoning.status: Designer recommendation discussed with user; exact room finishes and products are not final selections
finishZoning.dryFeatureWalls: Roman Clay is the current designer preference for the bedroom headboard wall and great-room feature wall bays; limewash remains an option for dry, low-contact decorative walls. The user has not selected a winner from the finish comparison.
finishZoning.otherWalls: Coordinating washable matte paint; bathroom-rated paint for humid bathroom walls outside direct splash areas. Keep applied dining-room trim in a compatible conventional paint system.
finishZoning.highSplashAreas: Porcelain or glazed ceramic at sink/cooktop backsplashes. Porcelain tile over an appropriate waterproofing system inside showers and tub/shower surrounds. Do not specify ordinary limewash or Roman Clay for these high-splash areas.
finishZoning.paletteContinuity: Proposed warm stone-look tile, warm neutral painted walls and specialty feature finishes should share compatible undertones; physical samples still required.

proposedDirection.costControl: Concentrate specialty application on selected focal walls; use coordinating washable conventional paint elsewhere. Price substrate preparation and finish application separately after site inspection.
proposedDirection.sampling: Prepare large sample boards in the intended method and sheen, including proposed topcoat. Review in actual morning, midday and evening light before procurement.

sourceNotes.note: Roman Clay is a smooth plaster-like interior finish applied in thin overlapping layers with a putty knife or trowel. Application takes longer than conventional interior paint; topcoat changes color and sheen.
Lime Wash is brush-applied, with soft chalky visual variation. Drywall requires the specified primer system.
Roman Clay prefers smooth substrates. Sealing depends on traffic and desired cleanability; sample the complete coating system. Limewash is typically not recommended on wood or metal.

latestFeedback.userFeedback: Entry: match second-floor wood color. Office: TV and soundbar in north cabinetry, artwork and small printer cabinet right of entry door. Media: clear entry doors, collectible shelves right of doors, less intense TV wall, soundbar, ceiling and behind-sofa speakers. Great room: sibling artworks above both consoles. Kitchen: better island lights. Dining: explore larger table for ten versus square twelve, fill space below high window. Living room: baby grand, Cloud couch, sheer drapes, two blueprint-derived angles. Sunroom: rectangular six-seat table, better chandelier, sheer drapes. All bedrooms: hard floors with loose rug under beds. Owner bedroom: 55-inch TV and soundbar instead of dresser art, art above bed, platform and bedside underside LEDs. Owner bath: artwork above tub. Bedroom 2: correct bed/desk/door layout; clarified headboard WEST and entry at southern WEST wall, desk right of EAST window. Laundry: graphic and exact wording “Rinse and repeat..”. Clarified oak/rug applies to penthouse bedroom too.
latestFeedback.interpretation: Preserve the individual bedroom identities and common warm modern palette. Propose rectangular 108 × 42 in dining table for ten, subject to actual circulation survey. Use plan-informed living room and explicitly record Bedroom 2 closet/door conflict rather than claiming its new layout is surveyed. All new images are proposals; measurements, products and trade details remain unselected.
